Served as starwars.com and cornellsun.com for widgets.scenario.json, through --host-resolver-rules. .online-chat-root-Verbox is a generic rule of AdGuard Widgets, .social-copy-container its starwars.com rule, #cds-donate-modal and body.modal-open:style() its cornellsun.com rules, and chat.quickcep.com one of its network rules. #FacebookLikeBox is a generic rule of Fanboy's Social, and bshare.cn one of its third-party network rules.
